1. Un kangalil mayagunen innum elavilai
2. Karaiginra nodigalil nan neringi vandhene..
3. Mugam paarka thavirkiren en iniya pungatre...
4. Nee indri Naanum illai en kaadhal poiyum illai 
5. Ore... Neiyabavam..
6. Ipaodhu enodu vandhaal ena..
7. Penne.. un mel pilzalilai
8. Un aalagai Varnika vaarthai undo..
9. Mudhal ne.. mudivum ne..💕
